meta.source: Merged export, Nov. 5, 2026: Claude Design project (Oct. 31, 2026) plus github.com/Vital-City-NYC/vital-city-design-system (Nov. 3, 2026). Values from tokens/tokens.css.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Default text and headlines; 1px card borders and hairline rules.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Default background, always. Text on black panels.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Hairlines between bands, chart gridlines, alternate background.

tokens.name: chartreuse
tokens.usage: Pop. Primary bar fill; at most one single-word accent per page. Full flood only on event invites and donation cards.

tokens.name: safety-orange
tokens.usage: Accent. CTAs, article kickers, nav hover, trend lines; chart series 1 unless NYC is focal.

tokens.name: periwinkle
tokens.usage: Neutral filler; muted text on black panels.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Secondary palette; chart series 5.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Focal. The subject of an analysis, such as NYC in a city comparison.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Muted text: deks, axis labels, bylines, source lines.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Secondary palette; chart series 6.

tokens.name: cerulean
tokens.usage: Compare. Comparison groups in charts.

tokens.usage: Stats-strip background on infographic cards.
